overview: Secrets Declassified tells the incredible stories of government secrets that have only recently come to light. This series proves that secrets can be uncovered, and mysteries can still be unraveled." Each episode will find Duchovny focusing on a different topic, speaking with different experts. Subjects include the real-life story behind Argo and the mystery of the Area 51 conspiracy. Mulder would approve. From black ops and bizarre experiments to deadly cover-ups and nefarious gadgets, David Duchovny pulls the curtain back on all the government secrets in modern history we always suspected, but were never given the answers to. Through the strange and shocking things countries the world over ? and those who work for them ? have done in the name of national interest, we?ll investigate the explosive evidence from newly declassified files that will finally shine a new light on what?s really going on deep in the shadows.
title: Secrets Declassified with David Duchovny

overview: The eight-episode fast-paced, nostalgia-fueled series will take viewers on a thrilling ride through America's past.
title: Hazardous History with Henry Winkler

overview: Mike Wolfe has spent decades tracking down elusive treasures, hidden gems and bargaining with awesome collectors of the past, but now, it's Mike's turn to share that history by revealing the stories of extraordinary finds by ordinary people. History's Greatest Picks with Mike Wolfe explores the epic journeys, captivating tales, and astonishing monetary values behind legendary treasures, relics, and artifacts from history. Mike draws on his decades of experience and infectious curiosity to showcase some of history's most unbelievable and high valued items—from iconic vintage cars and motorcycles to pop culture touchstones, rare collectibles, and historic oddities. With expert insight, compelling historical context, and Mike guiding the audience through these stories, the series reveals surprising new details about how these extraordinary objects have changed hands and risen dramatically in value over time—bringing history to life, one unforgettable pick at a time.
title: History's Greatest Picks with Mike Wolfe

overview: Set in a world where love is deemed illegal and can be eradicated with a special procedure. With 95 days to go until her scheduled treatment, Lena Holoway does the unthinkable, she falls in love.
title: Delirium

overview: Historoy's Deadliest will reveal the stranger than truth facts behind some of the world's most prolific and powerful killers.
title: History's Deadliest with Ving Rhames

overview: The history of mankind is inextricably linked with wars. Behind each of them there are hundreds of thousands of tragedies, millions of ruined lives. But not a single war has managed to kill love. It inspires and gives hope, protects in the fight with death. After all, love is life! In the documentary series by People's Artist of Russia Boris Shcherbakov "Love on the Line of Fire" there are stories of people who were forever connected by war, and about love that was tempered on the line of fire.
title: Любовь на линии огня

overview: This iconic social experiment turns traditional dating on its head, as Italian singles fall in love and get engaged — all before meeting in person.
title: L'amore è cieco: Italia

overview: In Vladimir, as a woman's life unravels, she becomes obsessed with her captivating new colleague. Full of sexy secrets and dark humor, the series is about what happens when a woman goes hell-bent to turn her fantasies into reality.
title: Vladimir

overview: Sprawling Mario Puzo novel about an Italian family of gangsters draws the inevitable comparison to "The Godfather", but does find its own direction. Headed by Don Domenico Clericuzio (Aiello), the family executes a rival gang on the night of the Don's daughter's wedding, including her new husband, the son of his rival. Unfortunately the daughter (Alley) gets pregnant and the repercussions of the night drift into the future. Spanning 1964-1985, the series jumps forward with the growing up of the grandson (Cochrane) who has grown ruthless and scheming. A co-rival in the family is a nephew (Gedrick) who has been raise to take his father's (Mantegna) place in the family as a hitman and has established his place by assassinating a man who killed a Senator's daughter. However, he is proven to not be ruthless enough and moves into the family's casino business in Vegas. When the nephew falls in...
title: The Last Don

overview: In the heart of a seaside resort, Stéphanie, Camille, Isabelle and Nafissa, victims of a serial rapist, decide to join forces to break the silence. Attacked at home in the middle of the night, they describe the same modus operandi, the same shock. A matter of life or death, they must speak out, louder and louder, to finally be heard by a desperately deaf community. With the help of Karine, a police officer who makes common cause with them, and Romain, Stéphanie's tormented brother, these heroines fight to rebuild themselves and prevent everything from exploding in their lives...
title: Après la nuit

overview: After graduating top of the police academy, Iris, 27, joins a police station in the south of France. Upon arriving in this brigade composed of colorful police officers, she receives a more than mixed reception. Her in-depth knowledge of law and her insistence on respecting the rules do not please everyone, especially Victor, 54, her designated partner, a lone cop whose methods are considered outdated. Despite their age and background differences, when Iris and Victor are assigned a case that is almost closed in advance, by combining their talents, they will discover that it is not a simple car accident but a premeditated crime. If success brings the duo closer, Victor will quickly discover that Iris is not just anyone's daughter... What secret from the past threatens to resurface?
title: A priori

overview: Fourth Wing follows twenty-year-old Violet Sorrengail as she leaves the life of a Scribe behind at her mother's demand that she become a dragon rider. At the order of her mother, who is a General in the military of Navarre, Violet enters the brutal ranks of Basgiath War College, which trains up-and-coming riders through the Graduate or Die method.
title: Fourth Wing

overview: Daria, 35, is arrested for gambling and sent to a community to perform socially useful services. Playing poker also means "reading" people: her father, Pietro, taught her this before he died in an explosion when she was only 9 years old. And it is the ability for which Ettore Napoli, of the Secret Services, asks her to collaborate in arresting Gemini, an exponent of international crime passionate about gambling.
title: Doppio gioco

overview: Professor Alice Roberts is back on the railways travelling thousands of years into our collective past. This time she's in Greece, to learn more about the Ancient Greeks and how they developed philosophy, art, theatre and ideas around democracy.
title: Ancient Greece by Train with Alice Roberts

overview: During an attack by robbers at the museum, Vadim is injured. This event awakens an unusual gift in him — now he can hear objects and even respond to them. The therapist wants to help Vadim and sends him to the owner of the antique salon, Inga Leonidovna, to protect the rented items. The voices of strange interlocutors do not subside: the superpower helps the main character not only to achieve success at work, but also to find love.
title: Положение вещей

overview: A global cataclysm, caused by a fatal accident in Geneva (Switzerland) during the implementation of the particle accelerator will lead to crew of vessel-school Estrella Polar to live the adventure of their lives.
title: El Barco

overview: The Premios PLATINO are organized by EGEDA (Entidad de Gestión de Derechos de los Productores Audiovisuales) and the Federación Iberoamericana de Productores Cinematográficos y Audiovisuales (FIPCA), with the support of the Academies and Film Institutes of Ibero-America. Their objective is to promote and disseminate Ibero-American cinematography and the audiovisual industry, boosting its recognition and expansion worldwide. Over the years, the awards have been hosted in Panama, Spain, Uruguay, and Mexico, bringing together the most prominent figures in the sector.
title: Premios PLATINO

overview: The old master trains for a century, thinking he is ready to ascend, but a hundred bolts of lightning destroy him. He merges with Zhao Feiyang, the Zhao family's fourth son, who's seen as a loser. Then, three marriage proposals arrive. From that moment, he begins an extraordinary journey.
title: Be Yourself

overview: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America features a rare archive and powerful first-hand testimony from witnesses—some sharing their stories for the first time. Former President Bill Clinton and former Oklahoma Gov. Frank Keating reflect on leading a nation in mourning, while survivor Amy Downs relives the harrowing experience of being trapped in the rubble for hours. Edye Raines recalls the frantic search for her two missing children, and first responders, including district fire chief Mike Shannon, recall the desperate fight to save lives. FBI Special Agent in Charge Bob Ricks describes the race against time to find the bomber and bring him to justice. The series provides an intimate yet sweeping portrait of survival, courage and the pursuit of justice in the face of an unthinkable tragedy.
title: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America

overview: Bloodaxe is an epic historical drama that chronicles the rise of one of history's most famous Viking warriors, Erik Bloodaxe, and his formidable wife, Gunnhild, Mother of Kings. As they fight for the throne of Norway, the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals. With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom, drawing in the ruthless Kings of other Scandinavian countries, and even a powerful English ruler, the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling and utterly magical new Viking Saga.
title: Bloodaxe

overview: A fantasy romance that takes place 400 years later when Heo Gyoon, a problematic character from the Joseon Dynasty, moves to the modern world to open a restaurant.
title: Heo's Diner

overview: Abdel Sattar, "The Devil's Lawyer," wakes up from a 20-year coma to discover a new world full of challenges and strange comedic situations.
title: Child Treatment Certificate

overview: Captain Hossam Ezz El-Din's life takes a wild turn after a mysterious accident, leading him on an unexpected journey full of surprises and thrilling comedy.
title: El Captain

overview: "The Green Room with Paul Provenza" is a talk show on Showtime, hosted by Paul Provenza. Each episode featured a panel of guests discussing comedy.
title: The Green Room with Paul Provenza

overview: El Nos — after renouncing his bad past, a pickpocket leads a crew into revolution. A must-watch comedy
title: El Nos

overview: The life of the family of thirteen, consisting of eight children still living at home, as well as mum Silvia and dad Dieter. Since 2015, Silvia has stood by her new partner Harald. Since some of the Wollny children have grown up and are having children themselves, the family continues to grow.
title: Die Wollnys - eine schrecklich große Familie

overview: Keanu Reeves and Gard Hollinger are kindred souls with a bond built on a love of motorcycles and an insatiable curiosity about the world around them. In 2011, they founded ARCH Motorcycle to reimagine what a motorcycle could be. To them, ARCH is a mindset, a lens through which to see the world. This is a journey of curiosity, to understand where human creativity comes from and to shine a light on the visionaries who are pushing the bounds of innovation and changing our world.
title: Visionaries

overview: The Louvre, Versailles, the Acropolis and the Alhambra are among the most visited European monuments. Almost living witnesses to the history of the continent, they are the treasures of our civilisation. Each of the episodes of this documentary series focuses on one of these monuments and offers a fascinating immersion behind the scenes of the construction of these buildings.
title: L'Europe des merveilles

overview: A shy lawyer starts a passionated relation with a mysterious woman. When she disapears, he discovers step by step her dark past.
title: Nainen joka katosi

overview: An air of transcendence only further stirs the swirl of ambiguity — is Poppy real? Is she a NPC? Do the puppets really die? Those that tune in will be the first to know. Or will they?
title: Improbably Poppy

overview: CDI: Código de Investigación is a groundbreaking true crime entertainment program that plunges into the most captivating and shocking crime stories. Each episode features in-depth investigations, expert analysis from criminologists, mental health professionals, police officers, and forensic specialists, powerful testimonials, and cutting-edge technology to bring viewers closer to the truth. CDI examines both past crimes that have shaken communities and follows current cases, providing live updates and exclusive interviews, all delivered with an entertaining approach that combines investigative journalism with compelling narratives.
title: C.D.I. Código de Investigación

overview: BET Amplified showcases BET Music's stamp of approval on the next big thing in music. Each month, discover a rising star as we spotlight a fresh, emerging artist through exclusive features and stories.
title: BET Amplified

overview: Michigan police Chief Laura Frizzo and Indiana Detective Jeremy Ogden team up to capture the enigmatic Kelly Cochran for the brutal murders of two men, her own husband, Jason Cochran, and her lover, Chris Regan. As the two investigators struggle to decode the mysterious murderer's mind games, they fall in love and marry, shortly before discovering that a sick & twisted marriage murder pact between Kelly & her husband may have left an endless trail of murder victims across the American mid-west.
title: Love You to Death: The Kelly Cochran Story

overview: A look at the lifestyles of a group of 20-something residents of the exclusive postcode in London, Chelsea, SW3.
title: Made in Chelsea

overview: "Comedy Club Ukraine" is a Ukrainian stand-up comedy television show.
title: Comedy Club Ukraine

overview: Within a historical and dramatic context, the series deals with the events of the Great Sedition, which is the period after the martyrdom of the caliph Othman bin Affan, through Ali bin Abi Talib's assumption of power, then the martyrdom of Ali and the assumption of Hassan, then the abdication of Hassan and the assumption of Muawiyah, and the assumption of Yazid, and even the martyrdom of Hussein in Karbala.
title: Moawiya

overview: The Eric Bana Show Live was an Australian television comedy and talk show hosted by and named after Eric Bana. The show began as four hour-long specials in 1996 called Eric. In 1997, the show settled into a weekly half-hour slot and was renamed The Eric Bana Show Live. It featured celebrity guests, music, comedy sketches and comedy monologues. Steven Blackburn was the band leader
title: The Eric Bana Show Live

overview: In Know Where To Hide: Who's Not Gone... nine VIPs take on the ultimate challenge in a game that everyone knows from their childhood. What was once an innocent game of hide-and-seek turns into a strategic game of cat and mouse full of tension and tactics.
title: Know Where To Hide

overview: Four Crush Stories
title: Close to You

overview: As thousands of angry protesters storm the Israeli embassy in Cairo, five Israeli embassy staff members find themselves trapped inside, as the steel door that separates them from being torn to pieces by violent mobs begins to collapse. No rescue force is able to reach them. The beseiged Israelis realize that these may be the last hours of their lives, and tensions begin to rise among them; Specifically between security agent Tal Shemtov, his childhood friend Roy Barzani, Chief of security and Shemtov's boss, and Barzani's neglected girlfriend Hagar, caught up in the middle with a secret of her own. At a time in history when political and personal interests mix, and values of solidarity and the promise that "no soldier is left behind" are left empty of meaning, unstable friendships and national relations between Egypt and Israel, are pushed to the brink of war.
title: Tahrir

overview: Mysteries for children.
title: Tybed?

overview: Pirate games for children.
title: Siangdifang

overview: Come to the little world of Modryb Baud and the four fingers in the company of Marged Esli.
title: Bys a Bawd

overview: Vinod is ready to build his dream house. But is he ready to face the hurdles in his path?
title: Love Under Construction

overview: Created by Lavinia Warner, Tenko told the forgotten real-life story of the women prisoners of the Japanese who for three-and-a-half years suffered severe privations in barely habitable Sumatran camps. Written by Jill Hyem, Anne Valery and Paul Wheeler, the series followed the experiences of one particular group of women from the Fall of Singapore in February 1942 and their subsequent internment, through to their liberation in September 1945 and their ensuing attempts to rebuild their shattered lives. A feature-length reunion special set in 1950, rounded off the series.
title: Tenko

overview: Me... In Real Life is a high school drama about a shy teen girl, her rebellious best friend, the chaos of social media, and the pursuit of her first kiss.
title: Me... In Real Life

overview: We love the brilliant storytelling, inspiring us to think differently, making us laugh and helping us learn... Today, Podcasters speak to tens of millions every week. Influencing pop culture AND public opinion. And now iHeartRadio is recognizing the top podcasts in America, based on the podcasts you say are the best. The seventh-annual iHeartPodcast Awards returns, the major Podcast Awards program where your vote will decide who wins. Over 20 categories like Crime, Comedy, Music, Sports, Technology, hundreds of nominees and special guests. The 2025 iHeartPodcast Awards will return live from SXSW in Austin, TX.
title: iHeart Radio Podcast Awards

overview: There are over 160,000 people employed in the construction industry in Ireland. These people build, renovate and reimagine our countryside and our towns. Welcome to ‘Na Builders' an original, home-grown series for TG4 that shines the spotlight on construction workers from across the country as they battle the elements - and occasionally each other - to get the job done. We'll be spending time with builders of all shapes and sizes, in rural and urbans settings; we'll be looking at what they are building and who they are building for and getting a real sense of where we are in building Ireland these days From bricklayers to electricians, plumbers to roofers, plasterers to carpenters these hard- working men and women are part of our everyday lives in Ireland. These are their stories.
title: Na Builders

overview: Áine Ní Bhreisleáin explores the Wellness Industry in Ireland - body, mind and soul. Áine has been on a journey of change over the past year with a pivot in career as she tries to find more balance in her life. Follow Áine as she tries the latest therapies and treatments and meets with people who have changed their lives in the pursuit of happiness!
title: Sonas

overview: Football fans, get ready! Total Football, a brand-new weekly show, is taking young fans behind the scenes of the beautiful game. This 10-part series is packed with exclusive access to top players, elite coaches, and the personalities who make football magic happen. Presented by sports presenter Aisling O'Reilly and rising star Rasdi Nsimba, Total Football isn't just another football show - it's a full-throttle experience. Each week, viewers will see insider insights from the biggest names in the game, while also taking on fun challenges both in-studio and across Ireland! From national heroes to international sensations, Total Football is calling in the stars. Expect to see Ireland and Premier League aces Caoimhín Kelleher and Evan Ferguson, current Irish stars Amber Barrett and Katie McCabe and former international Julie-Ann Russell - plus a host of surprise guests from the world of football and pop culture. But it's not just the big names making an impact; young reporters from across Ireland will also hit the pitch to interview players, broadcasters, and even sports photographers who bring the game to life.
title: Total Football

overview: Story of Masters will examine the roots of martial arts and its incredible disciplines, exploring how martial arts has made an impact on societies in different cultures around the world. The series will see Dan travel around the world in search of martial arts stories and legends, reflecting on the huge influence that this incredible combat sport has had on modern civilization. He will travel from Egypt to Rome, from China to Japan and Korea, ending back home in the US. Throughout the series Dan is accompanied by local contributors and together they will look at all the different martial arts forms. Just like the discipline itself, Dan's journey is one of Yin and Yang with physical and spiritual learnings.
title: Story of Masters

overview: Konstantin Ivlev will challenge Olga Kartunkova to decide who cooks better—men or women. The chef will assemble a team of professional chefs, while Kartunkova's female squad will be represented by the most experienced housewives, whose arsenal includes more than just borscht and vinaigrette.
title: Домохозяйки против шефов: Битва за вкус

overview: CBS' first attempt at a morning program debuted on March 15, 1954, with The Morning Show, originally hosted by Walter Cronkite.
title: The Morning Show

overview: Stand up humor based on real events! What can you do in Moscow for 30 thousand rubles? Why in the sex shop bell on the front door? Why do not they hold alumni meetings in kindergartens? How much does sex with his wife cost? What television show does Ruslan White most hate? And also trolling Cord, antidepressants against orgasm and much more in the new season the most life show on TNT.
title: Stand Up
Good Morning! with Will Rogers Jr.

overview: After rising star magistrate Lu Jiang Lai is brought down by a past wife-murder case, he's left injured, amnesiac, and on the run, only to be rescued by Rong Shanbao, the Tea King's cunning daughter. Once rivals, she hides his identity and demotes him to a stable boy to exact revenge. As Lu Jianglai plays along to survive, he becomes entangled in the Rong family's high-stakes search for a son-in-law. Amid power plays and hidden agendas, he and Shan Bao engage in a battle of wits that slowly turns into something deeper.
title: Glory

overview: Ten of Germany's greatest video creators are embarking on an extraordinary adventure: with two sailing boats and two experienced skippers per boat, they are embarking on an exciting race across the Atlantic. They will cover over 2000 nautical miles from Africa to the Caribbean. This epic adventure promises team spirit, challenges and unforgettable moments on the open sea!
title: Mission Unknown: Atlantik

overview: Join Motor Trend as we hit 200mph on a German autobahn in a Corvette ZR1, take an Audi R8 past the fjords of Norway, or drive a Lotus Evora 1500 miles through the Rockies. Epic Drives is the ultimate road trip show that puts some of the world's coolest cars on the some of the world's greatest roads -- and brings you along for the ride.
title: Epic Drives

overview: Get ready for the weird and wonderful world of footy every Wednesday night of the NRL season, when Freddy and The Eighth launches on Channel 9 and 9Now this Wednesday, March 12. Hosted by Danika Mason, viewers will get a a look through the quirky, weird and wonderful lens of two of the biggest characters in the game - the Eighth rugby league Immortal, Andrew "Joey" Johns, and the most capped NSW State of Origin player in history, Brad "Freddy" Fittler when Freddy and The Eighth is available to watch on Channel 9 at 10.00pm in Sydney and Brisbane, and nationally on 9Now.
title: Freddy and The Eighth

overview: Jake is drawn into a world of mythical creatures and adventure when he finds a sealskin hidden on the rocky shores of his father's seaside home in Wellington.
title: Secrets at Red Rocks

overview: Gaia is proud to present a 10-part series with Dr. Steven Greer, a renowned authority on UFOs and extraterrestrial contact. He is the founder of the CE5 protocol, the Center for the Study of Extraterrestrial Intelligence, and the Disclosure Project.
title: Disclosure With Dr. Steven Greer

overview: Sasha and Tanya have graduated and moved out of the dormitory. They now live with their son Alyosha in their own two-room apartment in the Moscow suburb of Yuzhnoe Butovo. And, boy, are their neighbors ever weird.
title: САШАТАНЯ

overview: The game, based on charades, had contestants and celebrity players sketch clues rather than acting them out. The game was played by separate teams of men and women, with two celebrities and a contestant on each.
title: Win, Lose or Draw

overview: Raw, unfiltered, authentic and personal, Vanessa Feltz wants you to tell her what's on your mind. Fiery discussions, a good giggle and plenty of afternoon gossip!
title: Vanessa

overview: In 1973, Calvin Parker claimed he was abducted by aliens in Mississippi. This documentary revisits his chilling story with new evidence and expert analysis.
title: The Abduction of Calvin Parker

overview: This is the second installment of a trilogy produced by Zhang Jizhong, preceded by The Legend of the Condor Heroes (2003) and followed by The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber (2009). The story concerns the adventures of Yang Guo, an orphaned boy in a mid-13th Century China. From his humble beginnings, the street wise Yang Guo gets passed around from one prestigious master to another but none of them will teach him any martial arts. While escaping from a tortured experience under Quan Zhen Sect's Zhao Zhi Jing, he meets Xiao Long Nu, the girl who will become his martial arts master and eventually the love of his life.
title: Shen diao xia lü

overview: Château DIY: Win the Dream will see aspiring chatelains compete in challenges to prove they have what it takes to win a life-changing prize: an authentic castle in France with multiple bedrooms, living quarters and outbuildings which could be worth up to £250,000 – lower than the average price of a home in the UK. The challengers will compete in a series of heats testing their skills in design, renovation, and business acumen: essential traits they'll need for running their own property. Each challenge will be guided and judged by the familiar faces of Château DIY's main series, who will share their vast and varied expertise of renovating and running these magnificent properties with the competitors. After three weeks of heats, a selection of successful candidates will be put through to the finals week where one lucky pair could win the prize of their dreams.
title: Château DIY: Win the Dream

overview: The Celestial Lord ruled the Celestial Clan with an iron fist. Ten thousand years ago, he launched the Battle of Immortal-Slaying Platform, forcing Long Xian, the Young Lord of the Dragon Clan, and Ying Luo, the Celestial War God, to perish together. Little did he know that Long Xian was his own grandson, bearing the Celestial Clan's bloodline. Ten thousand years later, Long Xian was reborn in his immortal form. Determined to maximize the success of subduing Long Xian, the Celestial Lord dispatched Ying Luo—the female war god, who had also been reborn—to the Dragon Clan once more. To everyone's surprise, Long Xian abandoned direct confrontation this time. Instead, he offered her the Position of Dragon Clan Protector, vowing to exchange his sincere heart for her true feelings and risking everything to turn her to his side. Amidst their clash of schemes, a bond of mutual sympathy grew between them. Unwilling to tolerate betrayal from his subordinate, the Celestial Lord sealed Ying Luo's divine powers. Their karmic bond spanning multiple lifetimes finally led them to repeat their fate at Immortal-Slaying Platform. Long Xian sacrificed himself to the sword and vanished from the mortal realm. Ying Luo waited faithfully for ten thousand years, clinging to the hope of reuniting with her beloved through a rift in time and space...
title: Love After Eternity

overview: The prequel to Hollyoaks in the City, Hollyoaks Let Loose followed iconic Hollyoaks characters, Ben Davies and Lisa Hunter as they leave their hometown of Hollyoaks in Chester and head for a new life abroad. However, Lisa's behaviour puts her and Ben's relationship at risk. She wonders whether she was right to leave Hollyoaks when confronted with the responsibility of looking after Ben's child. The series also touched on Lisa's battle with self-harm.
title: Hollyoaks: Let Loose

overview: For the youngest viewers.
title: Sioncyn Sboncyn

overview: Dr. Sandra Lee, also known as Dr. Pimple Popper, is the most famous dermatological surgeon in the world and an internationally beloved personality. She has dedicated her life to sharing her incredible skills with her huge audience, as she helps hundreds of suffering patients who are unable or unwilling to find treatment for their painful, oozing cysts, fatty tumors, and infinitely complex, life-affecting dermatological issues. Now, Dr. Lee is ready to take her practice to the next level. The doctor has made modern additions to her main office which include an entire new wing of patient rooms, and many new staff and doctors. For the first time, Dr. Lee will also be providing intimate self-shot footage of her life outside the office.
title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out

overview: Fans will get to hear backstage secrets and previously unheard stories as well as learn about the creative process and decision-making that brought each episode to life through conversations with guests like director James Burrows and cast members Kunal Nayyar, Kevin Sussman, and John Ross Bowie. The first podcast episode will offer a special look into the unaired pilot with co-creator Chuck Lorre and former Warner Bros. Television Group Chairman Peter Roth. Additional guests include Sara Gilbert, Christine Baranski, Vernee Watson, Sara Rue, and many more.
title: The Official Big Bang Theory Podcast

overview: The landscape of the Iberian Peninsula ranges from jungle-like forests to the driest deserts. In the north loom the snow-capped mountains of the Pyrenees and in the south flow the prairies. Filmed with super high-speed cameras and time-lapse photography, from the Iberian lynx to the Royal eagle; the ant lion to the dragonfly – this is Spain, wild and alive.
title: Wild Iberia

overview: Witness how asteroids, those rocky, mysterious celestial bodies, could become a new frontier for humanity in the near future. We are at the forefront of a modern-day gold rush, and asteroids could hold the key for private companies to launch into deep space. Dive into the science and engineering behind the companies leading that race, which potentially hold the future of humanity in their hands.
title: Asteroids: A New Horizon

overview: Raquel, a hard-working woman who works as a tour guide in Foz do Iguaçu, Paraná. She believes that it is possible to succeed in life with dignity. On the other hand, her daughter, Maria de Fátima, a young woman uninterested in the routine of the quiet city of Paraná, dreams of becoming a digital influencer and getting rich at any cost.
title: Vale Tudo

overview: According to the rules of the show, 22 participants gather together in a luxurious villa, where they will have to undergo tests and conduct a hidden struggle. Three players from the very beginning become "dark" - their task is to hide their role, eliminate rivals and manipulate the rest. The rest are "light", their goal is to identify traitors and save the team. However, during the game, anyone can join the "dark".
title: Мастер игры

overview: A new reality show in which high stakes, risky moves and brilliant combinations are on the verge of fantasy. "A big jackpot. Bangkok is a game worthy of Guy Ritchie's script. 12 star pairs, one suitcase with 10 million rubles, ten empty ones and one with a black flight pass. Here, every move decides everything. Bluffing, risky exchanges and big bets — participants can not only hit the jackpot, but also radically change their fate. And the presenters Pavel Volya and Laysan Utyasheva will not give them a minute's peace and will add spice to the game.
title: Большой куш. Бангкок

overview: The fallen princess, Nangong Ying, personally stabbed Crown Prince Su Wuying, who loved her deeply, to avenge her kingdom's destruction. Su Wuying believed his heart had died the moment Nangong Ying poisoned him. Yet five years later, when he saw her living in harmony with the young general Pei Xian, that supposedly dead heart still ached and burned with jealousy, driving him to madness.
title: Touch of the Frozen Heart

overview: It tells the legendary story set during Macau's "Silent tide" period, when Hong Kong banking magnate Ho Yin joined forces with patriotic youth Qiao Yinwan, underground Communist agents Ke Lin and his brother Ke Zhengping, and patriotic businessman Ma Man Kei. Together, they engaged in fierce battles of wits and courage against Japan's "Ze Agency" and its collaborators in areas such as finance, intelligence, and material transport. For the first time, the camera turns its focus to Macau during World War II, an "isolated island" that was never occupied by Japan, yet still bravely resisted and shared in the nation's suffering.
title: Silent Tides

overview: Shen Jiangli, the virtuous and kind lineal daughter of the Shen family, is forced into a relationship on her wedding night with Lu Jingming, the second young master of the Lu family, and later framed and locked away in the ancestral hall. After a near-death experience during childbirth, she survives, but her son, Yan, is born with a serious illness, and the only cure lies in the hands of the Lu family. For the sake of her son, Shen Jiangli returns to the Lu Mansion. There, she fights back against those who once humiliated her, uncovers the truth behind the conspiracy back then, and clears the misunderstandings between her and Lu Jingming.
